set.body: Add typed zoom/pan state and actions, configurable orthogonal panel layouts, and renderer-neutral coordinate plus per-layer intensity readouts. Preserve world-space picking, left/right conventions and panel receipt correctness under viewport transforms. Include host event translation and JVM/Scala.js tests; keep atlas lookup and specialized contour/depth layers as optional adapters.
set.title: Viewer pipeline 3: viewport navigation, flexible layouts, and readouts
